about: Wheatland County is a municipal district in southern Alberta surrounding the separate Town of Strathmore east of Calgary—not Strathmore itself. Hamlets such as Carseland, Standard, Hussar, Gleichen, and Cluny sit among grain fields, the Bow River, and Siksika Nation neighbours. About 9,000 people live in Wheatland County.
